sources_used.source: Edison Chamber of Commerce business directory (Accountants, Attorney, Insurance, Financial Services, Consultants, IT, Property Leasing & Management categories)
Web search (Exa) for individual business websites across Edison professional categories

categories_thin: Environmental consulting: very few Edison-headquartered firms; most environmental consultants serving Edison are based in Somerset, East Brunswick or outside the zone.
Title agencies and appraisers: only a handful of Edison-based firms have a public web presence; several directory hits could not be confirmed and were left out.
Staffing: most Edison staffing offices belong to national/franchise networks (Randstad, Express, PrideStaff, System One, PeopleShare) and were excluded, leaving few independent agencies.
Insurance: many Edison 'agencies' are branded franchise agencies (State Farm, Allstate, Farmers, GEICO) and were excluded, so independent agency count is lower than the raw listing count suggests.
caveats: Only businesses with Edison NJ addresses are included; nearby listings in Metuchen, Fords, Iselin, Woodbridge, New Brunswick, South Plainfield and East Brunswick were deliberately excluded as outside the zone.

A large share of entries (mainly small CPA practices, law offices and brokerages) come from a single bulk directory (iBegin) and carry active_evidence 'one directory only'. These should be confirmed by the triage team before outreach.
Some directory entries date from earlier years and may be stale; notes flag the cases I suspect (e.g. J.H. Cohn, Eisner & Lubin, Lipman Selznick).
Edison is roughly 7-9 miles from central Milltown, so the whole township falls inside the 10-mile radius; no part of the zone was excluded for distance.

Website fields are filled only where I saw the URL linked or opened the site; many small practices have no site I could verify, and street addresses shown as 'Unknown' were not published on the pages I could open.
data_gaps: Yellow Pages, BBB, Manta and WhereOrg returned HTTP 403 to direct fetches, so those bulk listings could not be mined beyond search snippets.
Overpass/OpenStreetMap was not queried (known to be blocked from this environment; not attempted at length).
Google Maps/Bing Maps place listings were not browsed directly; map-derived detail (review recency) is therefore missing for most entries.
Edison Township's licensed-business list is not published as a browsable directory; only a professional-services contract notice PDF was surfaced, and it covers firms already listed here.
Street addresses and phone numbers are missing for roughly 25 entries, mostly single-person professional practices whose sites publish only a contact form or a PO box.
